_status: TO BE VERIFIED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER. These are starting values for a first column grid, not the result of a structural calculation.
_doc: width / depth: size of a proposed column in metres, along x and along y of the plan. maxSpan: the largest distance between two columns along one structural wall line; longer stretches get columns in between, evenly spaced. mergeDistance: columns proposed closer than this to one already placed are left out. doorClearance: how far (metres) a column put in between may be shifted along its wall to stay clear of a door or window.
